// diagnostic

E0003

Expected a current statement form, found an unsupported or incomplete form

What

Expected a current statement form, found an unsupported or incomplete form

Why

This position accepts only a complete statement from Jet's current grammar

Fix

Write the complete statement form named by the diagnostic

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0003: tests/ui/cffi_retired_at_extern.stderr.

Error [E0063]: applied rules use `#`, not `@`
  --> tests/ui/cffi_retired_at_extern.jet:1:1
    |
  1 | @extern module c.demo {
    | ^
 Why: `#` marks attributes, instructions, and properties; prefix `@` marks compile-time names and fact reads, while infix `@` stays a package-source separator (D-VERDICT-732-1, amended by D-ONCE-AT1=D)
 Fix: replace the leading `@` with `#`
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0063

Error [E0065]: this function uses the retired `=` body marker.
  --> tests/ui/cffi_retired_at_extern.jet:2:19
    |
  2 |     fn ping() Int = "demo_ping"
    |                   ^
 Why: A one-expression function body uses `->`; `::` binds a name, and `=` fills a slot inside a definition.
 Fix: replace `=` with `->`; `jet fmt` applies this fix.
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0065

Error [E0003]: expected a call, binding, assignment, or `return`, found `}`
  --> tests/ui/cffi_retired_at_extern.jet:3:1
    |
  3 | }
    | ^
 Why: inside a function body, write a call, binding, assignment, or `return`
 Fix: e.g. print("hello") or x :: 1
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0003
